facts.fact: The Public Utilities Regulatory Authority (PURA) invited licensees, sector ministries, industry stakeholders, consumer groups, civil society organisations and the general public to comment on draft instruments including the Broadcasting and Online Content Regulations, 2026 and the Journalists Registration Guidelines, 2026, with a consultation window of 1 to 10 April 2026.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Trade (MOTIE) with the Ministry of Communications and Digital Economy held a national validation workshop on the draft E-Commerce Policy and Strategy on 24 September 2025, attended by government and private institutions who reviewed the draft in groups and gave feedback.

PURA issued the draft Broadcasting and Online Content Regulations, 2026 for public consultation on 2 April 2026, one of seven draft instruments released together (date is that of PURA's consultation notice).
